title: Trading in Shares Policy

tiers.name: KMP
tiers.description: Persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling Macmahon's activities, including any director; any closely related party of such a person; and any employee who in the performance of duties may become aware of price sensitive information or whom the Board deems to be KMP from time to time.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Subset of KMP; distinguished only for clearance process (Chairman's agreement, consulted with Disclosure Officer).

tiers.name: other employees
tiers.description: Employees who are not members of KMP; subject to the insider trading prohibition and the ban on hedging unvested equity-based remuneration.

definitions.hedging_definition: transactions or arrangements that limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements under any equity-based remuneration scheme

windows.end_anchor: the trading day after release of Macmahon's full year results
the trading day after release of Macmahon's half year results

windows.start_anchor: immediately prior to announcements in relation to any material changes in Macmahon's financial performance or changes to major contracts

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Macmahon Board may impose any other closed period from time to time (for example, when considering matters subject to the ASX Listing Rule 3.1A disclosure exception). The policy does not state whether the existence of such a period is disclosed confidentially.

rules.detail: No express derivatives rule for vested holdings. KMP are 'strongly encouraged to follow a long term holding policy with respect to their investments in Macmahon's securities (which includes derivatives)', indicating derivatives over Macmahon securities are within scope of 'dealing' and subject to the same Chairman/Disclosure Officer clearance and closed period restrictions as any other trade.
rules.evidence: Members of KMP of Macmahon are strongly encouraged to follow a long term holding policy with respect to their investments in Macmahon's securities (which includes derivatives).

rules.detail: Absolute ban on transactions or arrangements limiting the economic risk of unvested equity-based remuneration entitlements, with an automatic forfeiture penalty (not merely disciplinary), for KMP and other employees.
rules.evidence: All members of KMP and employees are prohibited from entering into transactions or arrangements that limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements under any equity-based remuneration scheme. Any hedging of unvested equity will result in immediate forfeiture.

rules.detail: Hedging of vested securities is not named; it is not caught by the unvested hedging ban, so it falls under the general dealing/clearance regime (Chairman or Disclosure Officer agreement, outside closed periods).
rules.evidence: Members of KMP of Macmahon are strongly encouraged to follow a long term holding policy with respect to their investments in Macmahon's securities (which includes derivatives).

rules.detail: Monetisation (e.g. prepaid forward, collar generating upfront cash) is not named or otherwise addressed.

rules.section: Directors, Officers & employees dealing in Macmahon shares
rules.detail: KMP are strictly prohibited from any trading of a short-term or speculative nature; short selling would fall within this prohibition though it is not named separately.
rules.evidence: Members of KMP (as defined below) are strictly prohibited from any trading of a short-term or speculative nature in the securities of Macmahon Holdings Limited (“Macmahon”).

rules.detail: Securities lending is not addressed anywhere in the policy.
CFDs are not named; they would likely fall within the short-term/speculative trading prohibition in substance but this is not stated.

Margin lending using Company shares (or otherwise encumbering Company shares) is not prohibited but must be reported immediately to the Chairman or Company Secretary; for a material number of shares Macmahon may notify the ASX.
rules.evidence: If a member of KMP enters into a margin lending arrangement involving Company shares or otherwise encumbers Company shares (“Security Arrangement”), then the member of KMP must provide details of the Security Arrangement to the Chairman, or the Company Secretary immediately.

rules.detail: Encumbering Company shares by any means is a 'Security Arrangement' requiring immediate notification to the Chairman or Company Secretary; not prohibited and no prior clearance is expressed as required for entering into it (only reporting after the fact).
rules.evidence: or otherwise encumbers Company shares (“Security Arrangement”), then the member of KMP must provide details of the Security Arrangement to the Chairman, or the Company Secretary immediately.

rules.detail: The Security Arrangement concept covers margin lending or any other encumbrance of Company shares, so a bank loan secured on collared shares is permitted subject to immediate notification to the Chairman or Company Secretary and possible ASX notification if material.
rules.evidence: If a member of KMP enters into a margin lending arrangement involving Company shares or otherwise encumbers Company shares (“Security Arrangement”), then the member of KMP must provide details of the Security Arrangement to the Chairman, or the Company Secretary immediately.

rules.section: Directors, Officers & employees dealing in Macmahon shares
rules.detail: No fixed holding period stated; a general strict prohibition on short-term or speculative trading, reinforced by a preference for single-order trades over trading spread out over time.
rules.evidence: Members of KMP (as defined below) are strictly prohibited from any trading of a short-term or speculative nature in the securities of Macmahon Holdings Limited (“Macmahon”).

clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: a Director should obtain the agreement of the Chairman (who will consult with at least one of Macmahon’s Disclosure Officers); ... Any permission to deal in Macmahon shares should specify how long that clearance will last.

clearance.approver: one of Macmahon's Disclosure Officers (CEO, CFO, Company Secretary or General Counsel), who will consult with at least one other Disclosure Officer
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: a member of KMP that is not a Director should obtain the written agreement of one of Macmahon’s Disclosure Officers (who will consult with at least one other Disclosure Officer) ... Any permission to deal in Macmahon shares should specify how long that clearance will last.

participation in dividend reinvestment and rights issues

short_term.evidence: Members of KMP (as defined below) are strictly prohibited from any trading of a short-term or speculative nature in the securities of Macmahon Holdings Limited (“Macmahon”).

exceptions.evidence: a member of KMP who wishes to exercise employee options or performance rights ... may generally do so during a closed period
participate in dividend reinvestment and rights issues ... may generally do so during a closed period

The requirement to obtain the Chairman’s or the CFO’s written agreement, as the case may be, does not apply where the securities are being acquired under a standing instruction under the Dividend Reinvestment Program, through the exercise of options or performance rights granted under Macmahon’s incentive plans or under an acceptance of offers made to all Shareholders.

financing_disclosure: KMP; immediately upon entering into a margin lending arrangement or otherwise encumbering Company shares; to the Chairman or the Company Secretary; immediate.
KMP; where the Security Arrangement covers a material number of shares; to the ASX; the Company may be required or may otherwise decide to notify.

exemption_authority: Not addressed beyond the Board's general power to impose or presumably lift closed periods; no stated hardship or exceptional-circumstances waiver from the clearance or hedging-forfeiture rules.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any hedging of unvested equity will result in immediate forfeiture.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar written over unvested entitlements does not merely breach policy, it triggers automatic loss of the underlying award, so the collar can only be structured over already-vested shares.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If a member of KMP enters into a margin lending arrangement involving Company shares or otherwise encumbers Company shares (“Security Arrangement”), then the member of KMP must provide details of the Security Arrangement to the Chairman, or the Company Secretary immediately.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The bank loan secured on the collared shares is not prohibited and does not require prior clearance, only immediate notification after entry (and possible ASX notification if material), making the financing leg comparatively straightforward versus policies that ban secured financing outright.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If shares are to be bought or sold then they should wherever possible be traded on one trading order and not over an extended period of time. This is intended to indicate the trade is an investment decision and not a speculative one.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring the collar and any unwind as discrete, single-order transactions helps avoid characterisation as short-term or speculative dealing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any permission to deal in Macmahon shares should specify how long that clearance will last.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The executive should ensure the clearance granted for collar execution states a validity window wide enough to complete pricing and documentation with the bank.

summary: A funded collar appears achievable under this policy, subject to timing and process. The put/call legs over vested shares are a dealing requiring prior clearance (Chairman's agreement for Directors; a Disclosure Officer's written agreement for other KMP), executed within the closed-period-free windows and outside any ad hoc Board-imposed closed period. Hedging is only expressly banned over unvested equity-based remuneration entitlements, where it triggers automatic forfeiture, so the collar must be written over already-vested holdings. The loan leg secured on the collared shares is treated as a 'Security Arrangement' that is not prohibited, but the KMP member must notify the Chairman or Company Secretary immediately upon entering it, and the Company may notify the ASX if the arrangement covers a material number of shares. No express provision addresses forced sale on margin call during a closed period or minimum shareholding requirements, leaving some execution and enforcement risk unaddressed by the policy text.
